title: 第五章 生命使徒第六章 天赋 特性摄取
content_zh:
，，！
当韩忠看着那个转盘，在少年的手下转动发光，凭空出现奖励，他第一个感觉就是，应该归他所有才是，毕竟他才是这间仓库的管理者。
对，这些都应该是他的。
而眼前的王长乐，不过是个可耻的小偷！
这个可耻的小偷，偷了他的东西，他要把属于他的拿回来！
什么，你说如果这个小偷不识抬举？！
嘿嘿，反正现在外面那么多吃人的怪物，死一两个人又有谁知道。
这般想着的韩忠，慢慢的把眼光放到了王长乐的身上，眼神中充满了恶意和戏谑。
“是的，现在外面已经是末日了！
这个叫做末日轮盘，外面的丧尸头上的晶体是启动的货币。”
王长乐看着韩忠将目光转向自己，他看到了那眼神中藏不住的贪婪和恶意，他知道自己这是被盯上了。
果然秩序沦陷的那一刻起，在恐惧，失望，血腥和绝望沃土上，人性的黑暗也会随之滋生生长，开出一朵朵恶之花。
可王长乐现在并不想和韩忠纠缠，现在重要的事情就是获得职业！
所以他希望能够用这个转移对方的注意力，从而避免纠缠。
“是么？！”
韩忠闻言，扭头看向身边的一个高个小伙“大春，你和强子去外面找点晶体。
看看这小子的话，是否属实！”
身后黄毛小伙和另一个黑脸汉子闻言，顿时会意。
转身向着餐厅跑去，他们记得那里有很多被人砍翻在地的死尸。
在韩忠刚说完话，王长乐就知道这下棘手了，对方丝毫没有要放过自己的打算，眼见对方丝毫没有让路的意思，反而在韩忠眼神的示意下，剩下的人拿着刀开始一步步向着他走来。

韩忠现在看他的眼神，就像在看一只待在的羔羊。
“麻烦让让我要出去！”
王长乐试图从还没有展开的包围圈侧面绕过去，却被逼了回来。
“小伙子，不要着急嘛，外面太危险了！
我那两个伙计啊，马上就回来了。”
韩忠看着眼前的这个少年，皮笑肉不笑的说着。
“等下如果你没说谎，再查查仓库如果没什么损失的话，我自然会放你出去的。”
见少年不断地后退，他脚下也不由得加快了速度，这个宝贝的消息，可不能让更多的人知道了。
“就是，就是，这里是我们珍珠湖大酒店的仓库，谁知道你在里面有没有偷我们家的东西！”
“小子。
我劝你，你还是老实的交代比较好。”
“韩老爹，你跟这小子废什么话，直接拿下就是，只要您说一句话，我大华第一个上~”
不断逼近的人，以及明晃晃的刀光，却让王长乐的心顿时一沉。
看样子对方不仅想要是轮盘，还想要他的收获，甚至是他的命！
果然，末日之下，秩序崩坏，他人即是地狱。
就在王长乐想着要不要拼一把的时候，忽然瞳孔一缩，猛地的看向几人的身后。
只见之前离去的二人，正一脸惊恐的跑向这边，而在他们身后还有一个巨大的黑影。
“我凎！”
当看清楚那黑影是何物之后，王长乐立刻转身，在韩忠几人错愕的神情中，向着仓库深处跑去。
“小崽子，想跑？给我站…”

“救命啊，救命啊~韩大叔！”
“有，有，有怪物…啊！”
“你们再胡说什么…东西。”
韩忠闻声回头，却见之前离开的大春和强子，正发疯的向自己这边奔袭。
在他们身后，是一个高约2米的丧尸，狰狞而恐怖。
content_en:
,,!
When Han Zhong looked at the turntable, which turned and glowed under the young man's hand, and rewards appeared out of thin air, his first feeling was that it should belong to him, after all, he was the manager of this warehouse.
Yes, these should all be his.
And the Wang Changle in front of him is just a shameful thief!
This shameful thief stole his things, and he wants to get what belongs to him back!
What, you mean, if this thief doesn't know how to behave? !
Hehe, there are so many man-eating monsters out there now, who knows if one or two people will die.
Han Zhong, who was thinking like this, slowly turned his eyes to Wang Changle, his eyes full of malice and teasing.
“Yes, it’s the end of the world now!
This is called the Doomsday Roulette, and the crystals on the zombies' heads outside are the activated currency. "
Wang Changle watched Han Zhong turn his eyes to him. He saw the greed and malice that could not be hidden in his eyes, and he knew that he was being targeted.
Sure enough, from the moment the order falls, on the fertile soil of fear, disappointment, blood and despair, the darkness of human nature will also grow and bloom, and flowers of evil will bloom.
But Wang Changle doesn't want to get entangled with Han Zhong now. The most important thing now is to get a career!
So he hopes to use this to divert the other party's attention and avoid entanglement.
"Really?!"
When Han Zhong heard this, he turned to look at a tall young man beside him: "Dachun, you and Qiangzi go outside to find some crystals.
Let’s see if what this guy said is true! "
The yellow-haired young man and another dark-faced man behind him heard this and immediately understood.
Turning around and running towards the restaurant, they remembered that there were many dead bodies chopped over on the ground.
As soon as Han Zhong finished speaking, Wang Changle knew that this was going to be tricky. The other party had no intention of letting him go. Seeing that the other party had no intention of giving way, on the contrary, under the signal from Han Zhong's eyes, the remaining people started to walk towards him step by step with knives.
The way Han Zhong looked at him now was like looking at a standing lamb.
"Please let me go out!"
Wang Changle tried to go around the side of the encirclement that had not yet been launched, but was forced back.
"Young man, don't worry, it's too dangerous outside!
My two guys will be back soon. "
Han Zhong looked at the young man in front of him and said with a smile.
"If you didn't lie later, and if there is no damage to the warehouse, I will naturally let you out."
Seeing the young man keep retreating, he couldn't help but speed up. He couldn't let more people know about this treasure.
"That's right, that's right, this is the warehouse of our Pearl Lake Hotel. Who knows if you stole anything from our house in there!"
"Boy.
I advise you that it is better for you to explain honestly. "
"Dad Han, what nonsense are you talking to this kid? Just take it down. As long as you say a word, I, Dahua, will be the first one~"
The people who kept approaching and the bright light of the sword made Wang Changle's heart suddenly sink.
It seems that the other party not only wants the roulette wheel, but also wants his harvest and even his life!
Sure enough, in the apocalypse, order breaks down and hell is for others.
Just when Wang Changle was thinking about whether to give it a try, his pupils suddenly shrank and he looked behind the people suddenly.
I saw the two people who had left before running towards this side with frightened faces, and behind them there was a huge black shadow.
"I'm stunned!"
After seeing clearly what the black shadow was, Wang Changle immediately turned around and ran towards the depths of the warehouse amidst the astonished looks of Han Zhong and others.
"Baby, want to run away? Stand still for me..."
"Help, help~Uncle Han!"
"Yes, yes, there are monsters...ah!"
"What nonsense are you talking about?"
Han Zhong turned around when he heard the sound, only to see Dachun and Qiangzi, who had left before, frantically rushing toward him.
behind them,It is a zombie about 2 meters tall, ferocious and terrifying.
